[[:Silver|Silver]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[:Silver|Silver]]:''' A complex process involving metallurgy and alchemy can bond '''silver''' to a weapon made of steel so that it bypasses the damage reduction of creatures such as devils and vampires.
Silver weapons have 2 points lower hardness then equivalent steel weapons, and as such aren't quite as durable.
